problem: Which of the following describes the level surfaces of the function $f(x,y,z)=\frac{3z}{x+6y}?$
worked_solution:
The level surfaces of the function $f(x,y,z)$ are given by the following equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x,y,z) & =c \\ \frac{3z}{x+6y} & =c \\ 3z & =c(x+6y) \\ 3z & =cx+6cy \\ z & =\frac{c}{3}x+2cy\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we get a family of planes:

$$
z=\frac{c}{3}x+2cy,\,c\in (-\infty ,\infty )
$$
